newsitem.title: GREECE: ALPHA, SIGMA TOP GREEK BROKERS IN JULY MKT SHARE.
newsitem.headline: ALPHA, SIGMA TOP GREEK BROKERS IN JULY MKT SHARE.

text.p: July trading volume at the Athens
stock exchange reached 587.62 billion drachmas, down from June's
940.23 billion, the exchange's members association (SMEHA) said.
The top two brokers, Alpha and Sigma, widened their distance
from the group of 62 member firms with market shares of 11.55
and 10.75 percent respectively, SMEHA statistics showed.
Alpha Brokerage which led in May had fallen to third place
in June with 7.94 percent of the business. It retook the lead
boosting its share with put-throughs in July.
National Securities and Telesis Securities followed with
7.87 and 6.06 percent with N. Devletoglou unchanged at number
Cumulative trading volume in the seven-month January-to-July
period rose to 5.22 trillion drachmas -- an impressive
improvement over 1996 when the entire year's volume was 2.53
In the first seven months of the year it was still Alpha
Brokerage and Sigma Securities battling it out for the lead --
their cumulative market shares at 8.64 and 8.41, respectively.
